overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, driven by mid-range fuel dryness (ERC 61%, BI 56%) with light winds and no rain.**
- Danger holds at Moderate all week, with fuel indices easing slightly midweek before ticking back up by Oct 24.
- Light NE-E winds (5-10 mph) and falling temps are the main drivers; better moisture arrives Oct 22-23 with up to 0.43" of rain forecast.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning or alerts are active for the area.
- No fire restrictions are in effect locally — Gunnison Field Office Stage 1 restrictions were lifted September 18, with only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remaining in effect, and GMUG National Forests and Ouray County rescinded their orders earlier this fall.
- Statewide fire activity is quiet, with wildfire activity across Colorado quiet, with no significant fires currently burning, and no incidents reported near Montrose-area counties.
